scrapers.name: Daraz Product Scraper
scrapers.short: Products, prices, sellers and stock from Daraz search and category pages.
scrapers.intro: Search by keyword or paste category URLs and get every product with its price, discount, seller, rating, sold count and stock status. Works across all five Daraz markets, in local currency.
fields: title, description, productId, sku, brand, brandId, categoryIds
inputs: Required. pk, bd, np, lk or mm.
Up to 100 category, catalog or search URLs.
Default 100 products or 3 pages. 0 means no limit.
uses: Price monitoring
Track your products and your competitors' prices and discounts every day.
Market research
See which brands, sellers and price points lead a category.
Assortment gaps
Find products with high sold counts and few sellers.
Seller intelligence
Map who sells what, where, and at what rating.
faq: Pakistan (daraz.pk), Bangladesh (daraz.com.bd), Nepal (daraz.com.np), Sri Lanka (daraz.lk) and Myanmar (shop.com.mm). Prices come back in the local currency.
No. It returns ratings and review counts. For the review text, use the Daraz Product Review Scraper.

scrapers.name: Daraz Product Review Scraper
scrapers.short: Review text, star ratings, photos and votes for any Daraz product.
scrapers.intro: Paste Daraz product URLs and collect every review with its rating, text, photos, videos, likes and votes. Sort by most recent or by rating, and filter by star level.
fields: reviewID, reviewContent, rating, reviewTime, boughtDate, relevanceScore
productID, productTitle, productUrl, productPic, productCategoryId, skuInfo
inputs: BD, PK, LK, MM or NP. Must match the URL's domain.
0 relevance, 1 most recent, 2 rating high to low, 3 rating low to high.
0 for all ratings, or 1 to 5 stars.
uses: Product research
Read what buyers praise and complain about before you stock a product.
Quality alerts
Pull 1 and 2 star reviews for your own listings every week.
Sentiment analysis
Feed review text into your AI or BI tool to score products.
Competitor weak spots
Find recurring complaints in rival products.
faq: Can I get only negative reviews?
Yes. Set star_filter to 1 or 2 to collect only those ratings.
Are reviewer names shown in full?
Daraz masks most reviewer names on its own site, and the scraper returns them as Daraz shows them.

name, channel ID and URL, avatar, verified flag, creator flag
video ID and URL, title, description, keywords, category, thumbnail, duration, publish date, views, likes

Collect every comment and ignore the limit.
Comments per video, replies included. Default 100.

Learn what viewers ask about in your niche, in their own words.
Sentiment tracking
Measure how a launch or campaign video lands.
Content ideas
Turn repeated questions into your next video or blog post.
Influencer vetting
Check whether a creator's audience is real and engaged.
faq: Do I need a YouTube API key?
No. Paste the video links and run it.
Yes. Shorts links and youtu.be short links both work.

scrapers.name: Google Maps Places & Reviews Scraper
scrapers.short: Business listings and their reviews from Google Maps, in one run.
scrapers.intro: Search by business type and location, a map area, Maps URLs or place IDs. Each result is one place with its contact details, ratings, hours and popular times, with its reviews nested inside.
fields: rating, text, translated text, photos, dates, reviewer, owner reply, per-aspect ratings
inputs: What to search for, such as restaurant or dentist.
A place name or a coordinate pair.
A search circle, up to 500 km.
Google Maps links or exact place IDs.
Default 20. maxPlacesTotal caps the whole run.
0 to 500. Sort by most relevant or newest.
uses: Local lead lists
Build lists of businesses by type and city, with phones and websites.
Reputation monitoring
Track ratings and new reviews for your locations or clients.
Market mapping
Count and compare competitors in any area.
Site selection
Use popular times and density to judge a new location.
faq: Is this an official Google product?
No. It is an independent tool and is not affiliated with Google.
Can I get reviews without places?
Pass place IDs or Maps links and set maxReviewsPerPlace to collect reviews for known businesses.

general_faq: How do I run a scraper?
Open the scraper on Apify, create a free Apify account, fill in the input and press Start. Results export to CSV, JSON, Excel or Google Sheets, or come back through the Apify API.
You pay per result on Apify, at the price shown on each scraper. Apify bills you directly. Custom feeds are quoted per project.
Our scrapers collect publicly available data. You are responsible for how you use it, including privacy rules such as GDPR when results contain personal information.
What if a site changes and a scraper breaks?
We monitor runs and fix scrapers when target sites change. For custom feeds, maintenance is part of the plan.
